title: The login is not root
exercises: The `admin` login (a different user from the profile's `root`, with the same password) is refused by the engine's own name check before any DB request: the log header, the start lines, the `error` message and the end lines, and no `ValidateUser`, `GetItem`, `ApplyItem` or `ApplyUpdate` call after the engine's own login. Nothing is created.

expect.message: Login name is not root. It is 'admin'. Check your config file.
